## Summary
<!-- What does this PR change and why? -->

## Type of change
- [ ] Content (lesson / muscle / exercise / quiz / source / asset)
- [ ] Feature
- [ ] Fix
- [ ] Docs
- [ ] Refactor / chore

## Checklist
- [ ] `npm run typecheck` passes
- [ ] `npm run lint` passes
- [ ] `npm run content:validate` passes
- [ ] `npm test` passes
- [ ] `npm run build` passes
- [ ] Updated `CHANGELOG.md` and relevant `docs/` (if behavior/schema changed)

## Content-specific (if applicable)
- [ ] Every new claim has a citation to an authoritative source (no invented references)
- [ ] New content starts at an honest `status` (draft/source_checked)
- [ ] Any image has recorded license + attribution + alt text
- [ ] No proprietary certification questions or paid content copied

## Security-specific (if applicable)
- [ ] User-owned data is scoped by the session `userId`
- [ ] Added/updated an isolation test for new user data
- [ ] No secrets added to the repo
